name: The End of Land
source:
Welcome to Sarnau city hospital №13!

Listen to patients, navigate the workplace drama, fill out endless paperwork, and try to keep it together while a big war is brewing on the horizon.

Remember, everything turns to dust. 

[From [url=https://rotatevacuum.itch.io/theendoflandpart1]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到萨尔瑙市第13医院！

倾听患者的心声，应对工作场所的戏剧性事件，填写无休无止的文书工作，并在一场大战即将来临之际尽力将其保持一致。

请记住，一切都会化为尘埃。

[来自[url=https://rotatevacuum.itch.io/theendoflandpart1]itch.io[/url]]
